description_paragraphs: This course introduces command-line usage and progresses to automating complex tasks in a Linux environment. With tools like WSL on Windows and bash on macOS, these concepts are widely applicable. Students learn to combine commands, use I/O redirection, and write shell scripts to solve complex problems efficiently - often without needing specialized programs or graphical interfaces. By the end, they will appreciate the power, brevity, and efficiency of the command line, while gaining deeper insight into how their systems work.
faculty: Prof. Gandham Phanikumar, Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Linux virtual machine setup; Command-line environment; Basic Linux commands.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Linux commands (advanced); Shell variables; Process management.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Combining commands and file handling; Input/output redirection; Software management.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Redirection and pipes; Regex (egrep); File search (find); Editors; Bash scripting.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Shell scripting - variables, arguments; Conditionals, loops, functions; Scheduled tasks.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: AWK - text processing, data analysis; Regular expressions in AWK; AWK as a programming language; Introduction to sed; Pattern matching and substitution using regex.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Build tools (make); File compression; Networking (IP , ports, DNS); Diagnostics; Log analysis.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: RAID; Git - workflow, branches, pull requests; Collaboration and issue management.

extra_tabs.label: OPPE
extra_tabs.standfirst: One online proctored exam on 20 Dec 2026, covering weeks 1 to 9, with a re-exam on 3 Jan 2027. It is worth 30% of the final score.

links.label: Grading document, Sep 2026
links.desc: Find this course in the document for eligibility, dates and the full formula.

extra_tabs.note: Sep 2026 formula: T = 0.05 GAA + 0.25 Qz1 + 0.3 OPPE + 0.3 F + 0.1 BPTA. You are eligible for the OPPE if the average of your first three BPTs is at least 40/100, and you need at least 40/100 in the OPPE for a course grade. If you are absent on 20 Dec, there is no second chance on 3 Jan. To be eligible for the re-exam you must score at least 20 in the OPPE and stay in the proctoring meet for 1 hour 30 minutes. No OPPE question bank has been shared for this course yet. If you have one, please send it in.
